name: Delta Air Lines
summary:
Delta Air Lines’ site is delta.com. The widget mark in the tab is the icon boarding-pass bookmarks use, not a generic airplane glyph.

Checked 12 November 2026 against delta.com. HTML came from https://www.delta.com/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: icon → https://www.delta.com/favicon.ico.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.delta.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 24038 bytes. Directory sizes: 64×64, 32×32, 24×24, 16×16.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

The only measured sizes are inside favicon.ico: 64×64, 32×32, 24×24, 16×16.
